newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki at new highs on forestries, Nokia steady.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki at new highs on forestries, Nokia steady.

text.p: Shares on Tuesday closed at another record, but off an intra-session life-high, on the back of sharp gains in forestries after UPM-Kymmene announced plans to up LWC paper prices in the first quarter, brokers said.

The general HEX index rose 0.55 percent to 2,837.45 points but sentiment was mixed, with forestry strength on one hand but trade in telecoms major Nokia nervous ahead of its results due later this week. Volume was a lively 840 million markka.
Nokia moved little but was lively after its rival Ericsson delivered 1996 results in line with forecasts, inching off 0.50 to close at 324.00 markka. It made up half total trade.
Confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki eased on lower- than-exected 1996 earnings, ending down 6.00 markka at 218.00.

Retail and wholesale group Sentra had another power session, adding a 23 percent gain to Monday's 63 percent leap, closing at 320.00 markka, as the share was revalued in a 90 percent surge after it bought parts of Tuko from Kesko.
Some investors remained wary with the focus on the big company reports ahead. Wednesday will bring Merita, Postipankki and Silja and Thursday Nokia.
"Investors are somewhat lost ahead of the big companies' reports," said one broker.
